moved back here to look after my elderly step sister in 2017.  She was registered with James Fisher medical centre and was extremely happy with how they looked after her, so I was happy to register
myself too. I was fortunate enough to get to know some of the doctors that visited the house. They were wonderful to her. I had an ongoing health issue which needed monitoring. I was blown away by the fantastic reception team, my first time meeting them. That has never changed, they care so much that has never faltered after all these years. I was taken ill and ended up in lCU fighting for my life. I did go to the doctors first by taxi and virtually collapsed in the car park. The whole reception team ran out to help me. A huge personal thank you to Jo.
Moving on,  problems with my heart have developed. When phoning reception saying l don't feel well can l book a call the reply is no, you need to see a doctor, then the doctor treats me or l   get admittedl to hospital.
This has happened 3 or 4 times all through the observations of that wonderful reception team.
I would like to add, a new neighbour moved in 3 months ago and asked about doctors. I told him about James Fisher. He said he had 2 others and would visit all as he would know by the feel of the welcome. He chose James Fisher saying, " I walked in and was made to feel so welcome, no brainer".The nurses are fantastic too, yearly check ups, jabs, bloods, tests.
I would like to say a special thank you to Doctor Dick, who takes all the time in the world to listen to me, never interrupting he works out the options to try to help me, I  never feel rushed. That helps so much when you feel vulnerable. Thanking all af the other Doctors  that have looked after me and responded to calling an ambulance when needed. I feel so very fortunate to be looked after by such a  professional and caring practice. Thank you all from the bottom of my heart.
Wishing you all a Happy Christmas and a wonderful New year for
